detail.longDescription: Alter is a Chrome extension: open it on any site, type something like "hide the sidebar and display articles in Hacker News format", or "give text more contrast and add a dark mode," and the change will show up on the site as a live preview. Save it, and it will be there every time you return to the site. Open source and BYOK (currently only Anthropic). It can also do one-off things like downloading the page contents into an MD file, etc. Not on the Chrome Web Store; download the ZIP and use Load unpacked in Developer mode. Would love to hear where it does poorly.
